edits.before: Q poke is your only level-1 tool — chain it on his step-ups but don't force anything; your power arrives with levels.
edits.after: Kayle has no dash and no CC — Q her every step-up and deny CS, but hold E; her passive move speed walks out of hook.

edits.before: W online — the burst-heal turns even trades into wins. Take the extended trade only when his answer is down.
edits.after: E online: hook, land the Q explosion, then W — pre-form Kayle has no invuln and your heal eats her autos.

edits.before: Riftmaker spike — your full chain with the W heal wins almost any extended 1v1 that starts even.
edits.after: Riftmaker's drain answers her poke, but Nashor's lands too — the curves cancel, so no free fights.

edits.before: - Kayle Divine Judgment (Invuln): matchup-defining — Invulnerability denies your execute — bait it, then kill. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E1 shield has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Kayle Divine Judgment (Invuln): matchup-defining — 160/120/80s, so a baited R buys you nearly three minutes of free commits. - Your E1 shield has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.

edits.before: That is Kayle’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: Her Starfire wind-up is the tell — the reset hits missing HP.

edits.before: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. First: Riftmaker into Mercs or Steelcaps; then Zhonya's and Cosmic Drive. Abyssal Mask vs AP.
edits.after: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. First: Riftmaker into Mercs; add Oblivion Orb — her W heals on a flat 15s. Then Zhonya's.
